title: Agent MCP server MVP: Vite plugin, editor bridge, protocol package
description: Foundation for the agent control interface (docs/19-agent-interface.md §Architecture, §Implementation plan step 1). The public surface is an MCP server — NOT a custom JSON-RPC protocol. Deliverables: (1) new workspace package packages/agent-protocol (@flash/agent-protocol) with zod schemas + TS types for every editor command's params/result (MVP scope: editor_status, doc_get with JSON-pointer path, doc_summary), shared by the plugin and the editor registry; (2) vite-plugin-agent-mcp registered in apps/desktop/vite.config.ts hosting an MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint at /mcp via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk McpServer (validate Origin/Host against localhost to block DNS rebinding; optional FLASH_AGENT_TOKEN bearer check), plus a PRIVATE WebSocket bridge on /__agent that the editor page dials as role=editor — the plugin forwards each MCP tool call to the editor and returns the reply as the tool result; if no editor page is connected, tools fail fast with an actionable message; (3) editor-side bridge client in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/ that connects when import.meta.env.DEV or VITE_FLASH_TEST=1, reconnects with backoff, and dispatches to a minimal AgentCommandRegistry implementing editor_status, doc_get, doc_summary; (4) the flash://document/summary MCP resource; (5) server instructions field teaching usage doctrine (doc_summary first, rev semantics). Include a doc revision counter (rev) bumped on every pushDoc and returned by all commands. Tests: unit tests for the plugin forwarding logic + an e2e spec in apps/desktop/e2e that connects a stock MCP TS SDK client to http://localhost:1420/mcp against the auto-started dev server and round-trips editor_status/doc_summary. See docs/19-agent-interface.md for exact semantics.
